Professional Summary
QA Automation Engineer with experience designing and executing automated test suites for payment platform features. Skilled at building reliable, maintainable test automation, integrating tests into CI, and collaborating with cross-functional Agile teams to improve product quality. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Automation Testing, TestNG, Postman, Git, Agile

Work Experience
QA Automation Engineer, Razorpay (Oct 2025 - Present)
- Developed and maintained Selenium-based automation suites for browser-based payment flows, reducing manual regression time by automating critical end-to-end paths; leveraged TestNG for structured test execution and reporting.
- Implemented API test collections in Postman for payment gateway endpoints and integrated them into CI pipelines using Git hooks to run automated checks on every merge.
- Worked within Agile sprint cycles to create automation stories, review acceptance criteria, and pair with developers to triage defects, improving release stability and lowering escape defects.
- Enhanced test reliability by introducing retries, explicit waits, and page object patterns in Selenium scripts and managing test artifacts via Git.

Education
BBA, Christ University
